source_evidence: Player exact 'My attacks should be psychic' corrects prior R2 physical dart; in context adopt specific campaign exception allowing main Soulknife Psychic Blade on a readied attack reaction, visual inherited floating sword, psychic 1d6+4, melee+7 or thrown+9 (60ft no long range) and eligible Sneak Attack2d6 psychic. This supersedes conflicting prior Ready restriction for V's main Psychic Blade; no bonus blade or extra attack from Ready, no resource cost. Standing V dice delegation until stop persists. Further correction: prior assistant claims of executed initiative and R1/R2 dice were false (no RNG call), so all such purported dice and dependent outcomes invalid; openly disclosed before re-adjudicating. Actual container Python secrets RNG initiative V face9+5=14, Cirren10+2=12, shared perytons4+1=5, Fenar2+2=4, Mara2+0=2 (provisional noncombatant modifier). No surprise. R1 V at(10,-5,0) Ready thrown main Psychic Blade on enemy entering melee with ally; Cirren(10,5,0) Ready Toll the Dead; perytons Dash from pinned positions to P1(30,10,40),P2(50,-5,47),P3(35,5,40) (all within120ft movement), no attacks, Fenar moves(20,5,0), BA Rage4→3 Beast Claws magic, Ready one magical claw when enemy comes within5ft. Mara withdraws inside coach. R2 V and Cirren renew same Ready actions, no slots or player limited resources. P1 dives straight >=30ft toward Fenar, enters her melee reach; V reaction thrown Psychic Blade actual natural1 MISS, no damage (pre-generated but unused damage dice not applied); Fenar reaction magical Beast claw face8+8=16 vsAC13 HIT, d6face3+7=10 magical slashing P1 33→23; Cirren reaction Toll the Dead Wisdom save face14+1=15 vsDC16 FAIL, wounded2d12 faces4,9=13 necrotic P1 23→10. P1 Gore nat20 critical vs Fenar AC14, Dive Attack qualifies: 6d8 faces3,1,1,4,8,7 +3=27 piercing, Rage resistance floor half13, Fenar59→46. Talons face2+5=7 MISS. P2 straight dive toward V within5ft (56.7ft), Gore5+5=10 MISS, Talons8+5=13 MISS AC19. P3 dives toward Cirren, Gore8+5=13 MISS, Talons8+5=13 MISS AC18. Each uses remaining legal movement to fly up with Flyby (P1 roughly28ft altitude above Fenar, P2 approx8ft above V, P3 approx23ft above Cirren); no OAs. Fenar then R2 BA Shift3→2, gains6THP, no fang within5ft; Ready magical claw again for next dive; no Reckless Attack off-turn. Mara stays sheltered. R3 V turn pending; V and Cirren reactions used R2, V restored at start R3, Fenar reaction refreshed on R2 turn then unused. Cirren concentration ended on release, all slots/CD full. V48/48 all pools full; Fenar46/59 +6THP, Rage3/4 active, Shift2/3 active MP6/6. LongRest0/6 (damage and Rage/Shift), time still~10:20. P1 10/33 P2/P3 33/33, all airborne. All prior unexecuted roll outcomes superseded, no duplicated damage or resource spend. Purse391gp9sp6cp, rations21/feed28, PixieDust1, all other custody/route unchanged. User controls V next turn.
